question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

The traffic sergeant proved through the test that Raj was __under the Influence of drugs and alcohol.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Inebriated **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inebriated **means intoxicated or drunk, which is the intended meaning of the sentence. (नशे में या नशे में धुत्त)

 
 
• **For example**: *He became inebriated after drinking too much at the party.*
 
 
 
• The word is appropriate in this context because it specifically refers to the influence of drugs and alcohol.
 
• It is a more formal and precise word choice than some of the other options.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simonised **means to polish a motor vehicle. (मोटर वाहन को चमकाने के लिए)
 
• **Ponied **means to pay a sum of money, especially as a contribution or unavoidable expense. (धनराशि का भुगतान करना, विशेष रूप से योगदान या अपरिहार्य व्यय के रूप में)
 
• **Pocked **means marked or indented with small hollows. (छोटे-छोटे गड्ढों से चिह्नित या इंडेंट किया हुआ)
